verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents multi-user tenant isolation, fine-grained admin permission controls, and self-hosting via Docker (container-level isolation of the app), which offer some containment. However, there's no evidence of tool-specific sandboxing (e.g., VM/container isolation per agent tool call), granular tool-use policies, or documented permission modes limiting what an individual agent skill/tool can touch during execution. Missing for 10: per-tool/skill sandboxing or execution isolation, documented tool-permission policy framework, and independent verification of containment against risky tool runs.
